messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: hosted-api us-east — GPU pool 3 nearing 100% alloc, request-queue p95>2s p99>12s, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (provisioner quota errors). Pager: @oncall-jen :rotating_light:
oncall-jen: on it. pulling dashboards now — heartbeat. cc @sre-miguel @infra-ron
sre-miguel: seeing repeated errors from provisioner: `QuotaExceeded: InsufficientAcceleratorQuota` in cloud API, retries backoff. logs: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted/queue?orgId=1&from=now-30m
infra-ron: confirmed. quota returned 403s from provider side for us-east-2. Provisioner keeps requeuing but cloud rejects crea te. trying a manual warm start of a thinpool (if quota temporary fallback)
support-anya: getting customer reports: some customers seeing timeouts on multi-token generations, backlog >= 6k requests. CS ticket thread: https://zendesk.redwood/desk/12345 — small set of high-traffic customers hitting primary route
product-elena: estimate impact: several customers on paid tiers may see p99 latencies/timesouts — ok to enable degraded fallback routing? prefer non-disruptive first
oncall-jen: action list: 1) enable fallback routing to ded pool 2) switch heavy tail requests to smaller model variant (quantized) 3) enable queue shedding on non-SLAs 4) notify major customers
sre-miguel: implementing 1 & 2 now. command run: `redwoodctl route set --from hosted-prod --to dedicated-fallback --policy canary=100` — switching only non-critical traffic first. also nudging autoscaler to force-provision with `--override-quota` blocked by provider 403
infra-ron: attempting cross-region spill to us-west as temporary. creating new allocation in us-west-1 (capacity available). ETA ~6m for first nodes to be ready. also opened cloud support ticket referencing `CRQ-8421`
support-anya: posting status update to customers: "We're seeing a regional capacity issue in us-east; traffic will be routed to fallback capacity and we expect recovery in ~10-15 minutes. If you see errors, retry after 30s." — pinging major accounts: @customer-james
customer-james: thanks for the heads up, we had a couple of failed API calls in the last 10m. Appreciate the reroute.
product-elena: can we enable short-term token-level throttles for exploratory endpoints? reduces tail load quickly
oncall-jen: yes doing `rate-limit: path:/v1/generate exploratory 10rps` now.
sre-miguel: fallback routing applied, small-model variant active for overflow. p95 dropping from 2s -> 450ms, p99 trending down from 12s -> 2.1s. queue depth halting growth.
infra-ron: us-west nodes starting to register. provisioning lag ~5m as predicted. cloud support acknowledged CRQ-8421 and says quota will be restored in 30-45m; until then cross-region stands.
support-anya: CS update posted and pinned. few customers still seeing intermittent 5xxs; adding retry guidance.
product-elena: planning follow-up: postmortem, create runbook tweak to detect `QuotaExceeded` earlier, consider pre-warming thin pools when high-traffic campaigns detected.
oncall-jen: handing to next oncall @sre-miguel for overnight watch. leaving notes: "autoscaler retries hit provider quota -> cross-region spill + model fallback + throttles." :white_check_mark:
sre-miguel: taking handoff. will monitor 30m and capture metrics for postmortem. scheduling incident report.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring. Tags: gpu, autoscaler, quota, fallback-routing
product-elena: assign action items: - infra: follow up with cloud quota increase request - eng-runtime: add early detection metric for quota error class - product: customer comms + compensation review
infra-ron: filed quota increase with provider (ticket 98765). chasing.
sre-miguel: capturing logs & traces: `trace_id=7a9f-queue-blast-1777654321`. will attach to postmortem.
support-anya: CS ticket updated and customers notified of ongoing monitoring. no escalations to legal so far.
customer-james: thanks team — latency is back to normal for us. appreciate swift response.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: autoscaler quotas restored by provider and cross-region spill capacity drained, system stable. Closing incident in 2h if no regression.
__notes: generated-for-dataset: unique slack incident thread about GPU capacity exhaustion and autoscaler quota errors leading to queue growth and mitigation via fallback routing, throttles, and cross-region spill
